name: jchat-e2e-web
description: Playwright smoke tests for the Expo Web build (the Maestro flows live in e2e/maestro).

scripts.web:audit: WEB_AUDIT=1 E2E_MENU_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100/m PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=artifacts/web-audit/html PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never sh -c "rm -rf artifacts/web-audit/data artifacts/web-audit/.account-lock; npm run web:audit:build && playwright test -c web.config.ts web/audit.spec.ts --reporter=html,list; node web/audit-report.mjs"
scripts.web:audit:build: cd ../mobile && EXPO_PUBLIC_MENU_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100/m npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist-web-audit --clear
